notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.content: PRIME WORKS proudly presents a new Exterminator spin-off title, “Exterminator: Escape!” Gather the whole family and participate in the premier of a brand new show! Fight the mouse in a different style, this time from afar! Load up with whatever you can find. Shoot-em-up and compete for high scores around the globe! We hope that people of all ages will enjoy our new game. See you on live on air!
